summary:
Main
Today, the DCE iron ore futures consolidated on a strong note. The most-traded I2701 futures contract on DCE closed at 720 yuan/mt,up 0.49% from the previous trading day. Spot prices of mainstream varieties rose by 2-7 yuan/mt, with traders adjusting to market conditions and maintaining a stable pace of shipments.
